# ConnectionStatus

Shows whether live updates (the WebSocket) are flowing: Live, Reconnecting (with the attempt), Offline (with the age of the data on screen), or a named source…

`SongNodes.ConnectionStatus` · Status

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.ConnectionStatus state="live" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.ConnectionStatus" state="live"></x-import>
```

## Props (ConnectionStatusProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` * | `"live" \| "reconnecting" \| "offline" \| "partial"` | Live-update connection state. |
| `attempt` | `number` | Reconnect attempt number. |
| `dataAt` | `string` | Time of the data on screen when offline (ISO). |
| `source` | `string` | Unreachable source name for "partial". |
| `form` | `"compact" \| "banner"` | Compact header pill or full-width banner. |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` | Retry handler (banner). |
